detail.readme_excerpt:
# skills The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem. Agent skills are reusable instructions that teach coding agents how to perform tasks, from reviewing code to working with a library. Discover skills at [skills.sh](https://skills.sh). Supports **OpenCode**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Cursor**, and [75 more](docs/agents.md).

## Install a Skill Requires Node.js 22.20 or later. Run this from your project: ```bash npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills ``` Choose the skills and coding agents to install to. Skills are installed to the current project by default; add `-g` to make them available across projects. ```bash # Choose one skill and agent npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines -a claude-code # Browse available skills npx skills find ``` See the [installation reference](docs/commands.md#skills-add) for source formats, private repositories, and all options. ## Other Commands | Command | Description | | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | | `npx skills find [query]` | Search for skills | | `npx skills list` | List installed skills | | `npx skills use @` | Use one skill without installing | | `npx skills check` | Check for available updates | | `npx skills update [skills...]` | Update installed skills | | `npx skills remove [skills...]` | Remove installed skills | | `npx skills init [name]` | Create a skill template | Read the [CLI reference](docs/commands.md) or run `npx skills --help` for examples and options. Experimental commands are listed [below](#experimental-features). ## Use a Skill Without Installing Generate a prompt for a skill, or launch a supported coding agent with it: ```bash npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines --age
